{{Top|leg}}
A '''differential regulator''' was a component of an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]], and were linked to the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] memory. [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2's]] differential regulators were burned out by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] while installing the [[Master Control Signal]] into his systems.
